children: Reserve Bank of Australia Gov. Michele Bullock has kept the door open to a further interest rate increase at the central bank's policy meeting later this month. In testimony before parliament, Bullock warned that upside risks to inflation "are materializing," while adding that monetary policy is well placed to respond. The comments extend a month of hawkish commentary from the management of the RBA, with markets nearly fully priced for another rise in the official cash rate this month.
